branches.description: Scoped difference-set, sequence and design implications
Exact witnesses and counterexamples within declared encodings
Symbolic coverage gaps and parameter-existence lemmas
Parameterized order transforms and composition laws
Parameterized block constructions and exact Gram conditions
Necessary conditions with explicitly restricted domains
Cancellation, lifting, equivalence and global proof obligations

decision_policy: First attack unresolved prerequisites; among viable scoped tests preserve branch diversity and revisit least-recently explored branches. Generality, novelty review and exact test cost are qualitative judgments, not invented probabilities.
